cds.title: University of Rhode Island Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 entering class). International: 553 applied, 411 admitted (74%), 34 enrolled; overall admit rate 75%. 'Enrolled' is the total of first-time, first-year students (3,431, full- plus part-time). The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column. SAT scores are submitted by only 23% of enrollees (test-optional); the Common Data Set lists ED (Nov 1) applicants 202 / admitted 150. Undergraduate enrollment is 14,466 (total undergraduates); international undergraduates number 178 (total nonresident-alien undergraduates).

cds_test_policy.notes: Common Data Set: students are not required to submit standardized test scores; scores are used for placement and considered if submitted.

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set (first-year, 2026-27; room-only $9,470, board-only $5,600). Only the college's own non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 126 nonresident undergraduates received it, average $26,565. URI's international page says merit awards have historically ranged $8,750 to $15,000 per year (those are first-year awards; the average above covers all years and may include other awards)
